cases.sql: CREATE TYPE wordrange AS RANGE (subtype=text, multirange_type_name=wordranges)
SELECT pg_typeof(x)::text AS t, x::text AS v FROM unnest('{[a,b),[x,z]}'::wordranges) AS q(x)
